name: Bite Originals
status: Awaiting human recordings; this file contains scripts, not audio.
performance: Playful, conversational sidekick. Warm sarcasm; never genuinely cruel. Natural pace, one complete sentence per file. No music or sound effects.

CREATED.line: Another side quest. Your collection is getting suspicious.
Added. A bold move from our planning department.
A fresh task. Let us try the finishing part.
Your list grows. Your legend awaits a checkmark.

STARTED.line: Movement detected. Finally, some plot development.
You started! I was running out of dramatic sighs.
There you go. The loading screen finally ended.
First step taken. Your couch will recover.

COMPLETED.line: You finished! I had a whole roast prepared.
Task defeated. Your reward is slightly less chaos.
Look at you, collecting victories instead of excuses.
One less task. Suspiciously competent behavior.

COMPLETED_LATE.line: Late, but done. The missing-task poster can come down.
The deadline forgives you. I need a minute.
Finished at last. We can cancel the search party.
A late victory still deserves a tiny parade.

OVERDUE.line: Your deadline called. I said you were buffering.
Plot twist: ignoring it still has not finished it.
Your task is aging like a forgotten sandwich.
That deadline left. Your task stayed for dinner.

SNOOZE.line: Later again? Your future self just requested a meeting.
Rescheduled. Your future self just requested a meeting.
Later it is. The task packed an overnight bag.
Rescheduled. The checkbox is practicing patience.

SNOOZE_REPEAT.line: This task has visited tomorrow more than you have.
Another postponement. Even the snooze button needs a break.
This task needs frequent flyer points for postponements.
Another delay. The calendar has started recognizing you.

IDLE.line: Your list called. It misses those checkmarks.
Plot twist available: finish one small thing.
The staring contest is over. Your checkbox won.
One small move. We can negotiate the sequel later.

TINY.line: Tiny task. Huge suspense. Where is the movie trailer?
We have discussed this longer than it actually takes.
Five minutes of effort. A full season of suspense.
This task is smaller than your excuse collection.

ABANDON.line: Welcome back. The checkboxes missed your complete lack of attention.
Back already? Your responsibilities saved you a seat.
Your tasks kept your seat warm. Very considerate.
The list survived your disappearing act. Ready now?

PLAN_DAY.line: No tasks? Bold of you to call that a plan.
One tiny task. Give this day a plot.
Give today one mission. Even a tiny one counts.
Blank canvas. Excellent time for one small task.

NOTIFICATION_CLEARED.line: Nice swipe. Your plans didn't move.
Excellent swipe technique. Now try a checkmark.
You cleared the message. The mission remains.

STILL_WORKING.line: Still working? Your task is awaiting the season finale.
Started is lovely. Finished would really steal the show.
That task is started. Shall we audition the finish?
Still in progress? Even loading screens take a break.

LOW_PRIORITY.line: Everything low priority? Your list is unusually relaxed.
A very chill list. Let us give something a turn.
Low priority, high potential for a little progress.
All low priority? Start anywhere; surprise the list.

SMALL_LIST.line: Short list. Plenty of room for a little progress.
A small cast of tasks. Give one its moment.
A few tasks waiting. One checkmark would change the scenery.
Small list, dramatic pause. Shall we move the plot?

NOTIFICATION_OPENED.line: You opened the reminder. The task awaits its turn.
Attention acquired. A checkbox would make this a sequel.
Reminder opened. Your task is waiting for its debut.
Welcome to the reminder. Shall we try the task?
